solves.reasoning: Passage opens with Humans excel at visual imagery → (A)=excel. Brains evolved ability to rehearse → (B)=rehearse. Representations never as authentic → (C)=authentic. All three match option 1.
(A) Brains evolved this ability → evolved. (B) without the risks or the penalties → penalties (not rewards). (C) perfect substitute → substitute (not original). Option 3 matches all three.

(A) Internally generated representations (from the text: 'internally generated') → internally. (B) This is a wise bit of self-restraint → self-restraint. (C) no incentive to find real food → incentive. Option 4: internally—self-restraint—incentive.

Original text says 'without the risks or the penalties'. ③ uses 'benefits' instead of risks — doing actions 'without the benefits' doesn't fit; the point is no risks/penalties during mental rehearsal. benefits is contextually wrong.
④ 'thrive' — the passage says you would 'starve to death' without incentive to find food; 'thrive' is the opposite of starve. ①②③ are all contextually appropriate.
② 'foolish' — passage says 'This is a wise bit of self-restraint'. Foolish contradicts wise, so ② is the incorrect usage.
The blank follows 'same regions to __ a scene as when you actually view one' — the brain uses same regions to imagine a scene. Answer: imagine.
Blank: 'no __ to find real food'. The context is that if internal model were perfect substitute, you'd have no motivation/incentive to find real food. Answer: incentive.
Blank: 'we can __ forthcoming actions, without the risks'. Mental rehearsal of upcoming actions = rehearse. Answer: rehearse.
'excel' means to be very good at something. Synonym = surpass (to excel = to surpass/outperform). 'struggle' is opposite; 'participate' ≠ excel; 'decline' is opposite.
'authentic' = genuine, real, not artificial. 'genuine' is the closest synonym. 'artificial' is the antonym; 'temporary' and 'ordinary' are unrelated.
'evolved' = developed over time. Closest synonym: developed. 'abandoned' and 'destroyed' are antonyms; 'purchased' is unrelated.
'internal' means inside/within. The antonym is 'external'. 'private', 'hidden', 'inner' are all in the same semantic direction as internal.
'forthcoming' = upcoming, approaching, imminent. The antonym would be 'past'. Options 2, 3, 4 are all synonyms of forthcoming.

(A) 'internal mental picture or model' — picture here means a mental image/representation = 심상. (B) 'took a picture of the sunset with his new camera' — picture = photograph = 사진. So (A)심상 — (B)사진 = option 4.
Definition: 'something that motivates or encourages someone to do something' = incentive. penalty=punishment; obstacle=barrier; restriction=limitation. incentive perfectly matches.
Blank: 'Such internally generated __ are never as authentic'. Subject position needing a plural noun; represent(v.) → representations(n., plural) to match 'are'.
Blank: 'on your __' part. The context is 'your genes' part'. gene(singular) → genes(plural). The apostrophe position after 'genes'' shows plural possessive, so the answer is 'genes'.
Blank: 'representations are never as authentic as __'. The comparison is with 'the real thing' = 실제 사물. Context: internal representations ≠ real thing.
Blank: 'rehearse forthcoming actions, __ of doing them in the real world'. Original text says 'without the risks or the penalties'. This means '위험이나 불이익 없이' = option 2.
